stemMd: The graph of $y=f(x)$ has vertex $(4,-7)$. The function $g(x)=f(x-2)+5$ has its vertex at which point?
explanationMd: The input x−2 reaches the original vertex input 4 when x=6. Adding 5 changes the output from −7 to −2. Thus the transformed vertex is (6,−2).

distractorRationale.a: Replacing x with x−2 shifts right, not left.
